// Keep test definitions in source, but exclude them from the production catalogue.
const UNIFICADO_AMBIENTE = 'producao';
const environmentItemIds = new Set([
  ...Object.values(MENU_CONFIG).flatMap(module => module.groups.flatMap(group => group.items.map(item => item.id))),
  ...window.UnificadoGedMenu.map(item => item.id), 'pcpUsuarios', 'prodUsuarios'
]);
window.UnificadoCatalogEnvironment = Object.freeze({
  name: UNIFICADO_AMBIENTE,
  allows(value) { const id=typeof value==='string'?value:value?.id;return environmentItemIds.has(id) && (!value?.ambiente || value.ambiente===UNIFICADO_AMBIENTE); }
});
Object.values(MENU_CONFIG).forEach(module => module.groups.forEach(group => {
  group.items = group.items.filter(item => window.UnificadoCatalogEnvironment.allows(item));
}));

const MENU_ITEMS = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(MENU_CONFIG).flatMap(([module, value]) =>
  value.groups.flatMap(group => group.items.map(item => [item.id, {
    ...item,
    module,
    require: module === 'planejamento' ? (
      ['programacao12','programacao34','circular3','dt4','programacaoFinal',
       'relatorio12','relatorio3','relatorio4','etiquetas','etiquetasSc','etiquetasSetor4',
       'etiquetasArmaduras','acompMensal','acompMensal34','formasPorSetor'].includes(item.id) ? 'PCP' :
      ['pcpDiario','apontamentoMega','producaoPcp','fechamentoDiarioPcp','maodeobra','maodeobraRateio'].includes(item.id) ? 'PRODUCAO' :
      null) : null,

      ? new URL(item.path, USINAS_BASE).href
      : module === 'suprimentos'
      ? new URL(item.path, SUPRIMENTOS_BASE).href
      : module === 'qualidade'
      ? new URL(item.path, QUALITY_BASE).href

      ? new URL(item.path, LAB_BASE).href
      : module === 'planejamento'
